record.title: Keeping water a source of joy
record.description: Water is part of everyday life in Limburg. It is where people play, relax and spend time together. They should not have to worry about water levels, data models or the technology working behind the scenes. But for the people responsible for water management, there is always a question: Can we see what is coming in time to act? Limburg experienced the consequences in July 2021, when every minute changed what was still possible. The information needed to understand a situation often already exists. The challenge is bringing data, models, systems and expertise together so people can use it while there is still time to respond. Together with Waterschap Limburg, Sopra Steria is working on exactly that. Where there is water, a clock is always ticking. Complex hydrological models can produce valuable predictions. But a prediction that arrives too late is just history written in advance. Tests with Waterschap Limburg showed that AI models can provide up to 24 hours of useful lead time. That can give hydrologists and safety regions more time to compare scenarios, assess the situation, coordinate, prepare flood defences and, if necessary, warn or evacuate people earlier.

record.title: Some things simply have to stay cool
record.description: It’s the end of the match. A girl reaches for a cold drink. Just like that, she cools down and gets ready for the next game. She doesn’t need to think about where the electricity came from, or what it took to keep it flowing. But behind that simple moment is a system performing a constant balancing act: keeping electricity supply and demand in balance, every second of every day, at 50 hertz. We notice how important that system is when something goes wrong. And keeping it balanced is becoming more difficult.

record.title: Free to get lost in the moment
record.description: On a warm summer evening, thousands of people stand together in a field, looking towards the stage. None of them are thinking about the air above them. And that is exactly how it should be. Because keeping an event, prison, port or other sensitive location safe increasingly means understanding what you cannot see. Small, sophisticated drones can enter protected airspace. The challenge is not simply detecting one. It is understanding what the different signals are telling you.

record.title: Conversational Analytics: una nuova esperienza di accesso ai dati per Italiaonline
record.description: Italiaonline , AI digital company italiana, tra i principali operatori italiani nel digital marketing, nell’advertising e nella comunicazione online, si è trovata di fronte a una sfida sempre più diffusa nelle organizzazioni data-driven: trasformare un vasto patrimonio informativo in uno strumento maggiormente accessibile al business. L’esigenza non era raccogliere nuovi dati, ma consentire a figure manageriali e responsabili di funzione di interrogare le informazioni presenti nei sistemi in linguaggio naturale utilizzando il lessico aziendale, ottenendo risposte coerenti con la terminologia, i KPI e le regole di business dell’organizzazione. L’obiettivo era democratizzare l’accesso ai dati, riducendo la dipendenza da competenze tecniche e rendendo più semplice, veloce e intuitiva l’analisi delle informazioni.
